_comment: Checkerboard geometry + 3 robot-frame anchor CORNERS for camera_calibrate.py. pattern_cols/rows are INNER corners (make_checkerboard.py 8x12 squares -> 7x11). square_mm must match the printed board (measure the 50mm line). The 3 anchors are corners (an L: bottom_left, bottom_right, top_left) so they are NON-collinear and fix the board->robot frame incl. handedness. Fill robot_points_mm after pass 1: run camera_calibrate.py once, open dataset/calib/checkerboard_detected.jpg, touch the robot tip to the 3 RED-labelled corners (BL, BR, TL), enter their robot X,Y in mm here, keep the board fixed, then re-run.
